Game Overview

In Green Snake, the core idea is straightforward: guide a growing snake in a vibrant challenge of agility and strategy. Devour food to extend your reach, but avoid perilous walls and your own twisting trail for survival. Can you master the art of seamless slithering?

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Green Snake is easy to pick up. Guide a growing snake in a vibrant challenge of agility and strategy. Devour food to extend your reach, but avoid perilous walls and your own twisting trail for survival. Can you master the art of seamless slithering?
